devices.name: Hermeneia
devices.definition: Interpretation: a plain restatement added at once to explain a figure just used.

devices.name: Periphrasis
devices.definition: Circumlocution: a description put in place of the plain name of a thing.

devices.name: Catabasis
devices.definition: A gradual descent — a series that steps down, clause by clause, to a low point (opposite of climax).

occurrences.note: Our Lord was perfectly aware that He was a born King

devices.name: Epitheton
devices.definition: Naming a thing by an attribute or adjunct added to it (“John the Baptist”).

occurrences.note: That they might know thee, the only true God. Here true is not a mere adjective qualifying God, but is an epithet: That they might know TheeGod, the only God, the true (or very) God. So

devices.name: Hendiatris
devices.definition: One idea expressed by three words joined with “and” (“the way, the truth, and the life”).

devices.name: Hypocatastasis
devices.definition: Comparison by implication: the thing compared is not named at all, only the image (“Beware the leaven…”).

devices.name: Allegory
devices.definition: An extended metaphor — a whole passage whose surface story stands throughout for a deeper meaning.

devices.name: Enigma
devices.definition: A dark saying — a truth wrapped in obscure or riddling terms.

devices.name: Diasyrmos
devices.definition: Mockery that belittles an opponent's argument by raillery.

devices.name: Epitrope
devices.definition: Admission or permission — ironically conceding a point (“Fill up the measure of your fathers”).

occurrences.note: That thou doest, do quickly. The Lord is not sanctioning the evil, but permitting it

devices.name: Protherapeia
devices.definition: Conciliation — softening words used first to win a hearing for what follows.
